hist-mod-03-c1.text: Spencer Weart (2026). The Carbon Dioxide Greenhouse Effect. The Discovery of Global Warming, American Institute of Physics.
hist-mod-03-c1.quote: At the turn of the century, Svante Arrhenius calculated that emissions from human industry might someday bring a global warming.
hist-mod-03-c1.claim: Swedish scientist Svante Arrhenius calculated in 1896 that burning coal could warm the planet (the greenhouse effect itself had been described decades earlier by Fourier, Foote and Tyndall).

hist-mod-03-c1.text: Spencer Weart (2026). The Public and Climate Change Since 1980. The Discovery of Global Warming, American Institute of Physics.
hist-mod-03-c1.quote: Inside, the audience sweated as Hansen said "with 99% confidence" that a long-term warming trend was underway, and that he strongly suspected the greenhouse effect was the cause.
hist-mod-03-c1.claim: NASA scientist James Hansen testified to Congress in 1988 that human-caused global warming had begun.

hist-mod-04-c1.text: Robert Rich. The Great Recession. Federal Reserve History.
hist-mod-04-c1.quote: Real gross domestic product (GDP) fell 4.3 percent from its peak in 2007Q4 to its trough in 2009Q2, the largest decline in the postwar era (based on data as of October 2013).
hist-mod-04-c1.claim: The Global Financial Crisis of 2007–2009 was the worst economic crisis since the Great Depression.

hist-mod-04-c1.text: John Weinberg. The Great Recession and Its Aftermath. Federal Reserve History.

hist-mod-04-c1.claim: Lehman Brothers collapsed on September 15, 2008, triggering a global credit freeze.

hist-mod-06-c2.text: (2022). 14.9 million excess deaths associated with the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020 and 2021. World Health Organization.
hist-mod-06-c2.quote: New estimates from the World Health Organization (WHO) show that the full death toll associated directly or indirectly with the COVID-19 pandemic (described as “excess mortality”) between 1 January 2020 and 31 December 2021 was approximately 14.9 million (range 13.3 million to 16.6 million).
hist-mod-06-c2.claim: By 2024 had killed ~7 million confirmed (likely 15-20+ million when excess mortality is counted).
